subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA redlines, SOC2 link, and subprocessor list for PO
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@auroratech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AuroraTech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake — security pack & PO flow

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Procurement asked that we get the following items before we can raise a PO and route through our finance system:

- Final DPA (we've attached our template for your redline)
- SOC 2 report (latest completed audit)
- Current subprocessor inventory
- Vendor company legal name and W-9/Tax ID (if US)

I've attached the DPA template we prefer and a checklist. Can you confirm turnaround on redlines and whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 link (hosted report or AICPA portal) and an exportable subprocessor CSV?

We need to hit end of week for our purchasing cutoff.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Lemaire
Vendor Operations | AuroraTech
[Attachment: AuroraTech_DPA_template.docx (DOCX)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@auroratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security pack & PO flow

Hi Sophie — thanks for the checklist and the template.

Quick answers:
- DPA: we're starting a focused review of your template now. We'll push a redline back by EOD Friday (attached as PDF for ease).
- SOC 2: we host our report on a secure portal and can share a read-only link plus a PDF export. See link below — sending the PDF as an attachment as well.
- Subprocessors: we can provide the current inventory as CSV; will attach and also paste a short list in the body for immediate review.

Immediate ask for you: is AuroraTech able to accept Redwood's standard limited liability cap (section 7 in our redline)? If not, flag which clause and we can route to legal.

Attachments: AuroraTech_DPA_redline_v2.pdf; AuroraTech_Soc2_report_Q42026.pdf; subprocessors_list_auroratech.csv

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AuroraTech_DPA_redline_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: AuroraTech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security pack & PO flow

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 10:43 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sophie — thanks for the checklist and the template.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few procurement items to confirm so we can generate PO:

1) Legal name and tax ID for the PO: 
   - Please confirm the exact legal entity name you want on the PO and the US EIN (or international VAT/Tax ID).
2) Invoice routing: who should we send the invoice to (email + billing contact)?
3) Acceptable payment terms: Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60? If Net 30, confirm early-payment discount options.

Regarding the DPA, our legal team flagged Redwood's liability cap as a blocking item for our standard contract. If you can confirm an internal escalation path (who at Redwood will approve an exception), that will speed things up.

We have a purchasing cutoff on Monday at 10:00 AM PT for April payments.

Procurement team
AuroraTech
[Related link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345 — we will send the PO via DocuSign once the DPA is final]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@auroratech.com>, AuroraTech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security pack & PO flow

Hi Sophie / Procurement — looping in Marshall (legal) is necessary for the liability cap. Marcus (cc'ed) will kick off that thread internally but here's the quick path:

- If AuroraTech requires our liability cap to be raised to match their standard, we can route to our General Counsel for approval. Typical timeline: 2-4 business days for review and a short negotiation call if needed.
- If you can provide the clause you need (exact language) we can evaluate faster.

Also answering procurement items: 
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN (US): 46-1234567
- Invoice email: ap@redwoodinference.com (please cc billing@redwoodinference.com)
- Payment terms: Net 30 default; we can evaluate Net 45 upon request.

For immediate PO readiness: once the DPA redline and SOC 2 link are accepted and legal confirms the cap exception or AuroraTech accepts Redwood's standard cap, Procurement can create the PO and send via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessors_list_auroratech.csv (CSV)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: AuroraTech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>, Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@auroratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security pack & PO flow

Thanks — quick status update to keep the purchase window: 

- DPA: We accepted a single change to liability language to provide a modest exception for data breach scenarios; legal has signed off on the redline (attached). Please review the attached PDF (AuroraTech_DPA_redline_v2.pdf) and confirm acceptance.
- SOC 2: link to read-only report — https://hosting.example.com/soc2/auroratech-q42026.pdf (PDF attached).
- Subprocessors: CSV attached and key entries pasted below:
   - AWS (us-east-1) — cloud infra
   - Sentry (error monitoring) — SaaS
   - Segment (analytics) — data routing

PO details confirmed: Redwood legal name and EIN (Ben's email). We accept Net 30. Invoice routing to ap@redwoodinference.com.

If procurement can create the PO and route via DocuSign today, we will countersign upon receipt.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: AuroraTech_DPA_redline_v2.pdf, AuroraTech_Soc2_report_Q42026.pdf, subprocessors_list_auroratech.csv]
